description: Header file defining the API for accessing CID font information in the FreeType project, including functions to retrieve CID registry, check if a font is CID-keyed, and get CID from glyph index.

methods.name: FT_Get_CID_Registry_Ordering_Supplement
methods.description: Retrieves the Registry/Ordering/Supplement triple from a CID-keyed font.

methods.name: FT_Get_CID_Is_Internally_CID_Keyed
methods.description: Checks if a font face is CID-keyed or not.

methods.name: FT_Get_CID_From_Glyph_Index
methods.description: Retrieves the CID corresponding to a glyph index.
